subject: Web Development
title: The SolarWinds Supply Chain Attack
description: A micro-lesson that makes The SolarWinds Supply Chain Attack usable.

hook.text: In 2020, hackers compromised SolarWinds' software update system used by 18,000 organizations.

buildup.text: Malicious code was inserted into a legitimate software update that customers installed trustingly.

discovery.text: US government agencies, Fortune 500 companies, and security firms were all compromised.

twist.text: The attack went undetected for nine months. The attackers had access the entire time.

climax.text: SolarWinds showed that supply chain trust is one of cybersecurity's hardest unsolved problems.

punchline.text: Trusted updates delivered the attack itself.

quiz.question: How was the SolarWinds attack delivered?
